question: The first and only disabled person to hold the position of State Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities in the history of state, awarded with Padma Shri in 2024, Dr. KS Rajanna belongs to which of the following Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dr. KS Rajanna is from the state of Karnataka, India.
 
• He is the first and only disabled person to hold the position of State Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities in Karnataka.
 
• Dr. KS Rajanna was awarded the prestigious Padma Shri in 2024.
 
• His contributions to the welfare and rights of disabled persons in Karnataka have been widely recognized.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Shri**:

 
 
• Padma Shri is one of the highest civilian awards in India, presented annually on Republic Day.
 
• The award recognizes distinguished service in various fields such as arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• It is the fourth highest civilian award in the Republic of India, after the Bharat Ratna, the Padma Vibhushan, and the Padma Bhushan.
 
 
 
• **State Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities**:
 
 
• The office is responsible for implementing the policies and schemes for the welfare of persons with disabilities at the state level.
 
• The Commissioner ensures the protection of rights and full participation of persons with disabilities in society.
 
• The role involves monitoring the implementation of various acts and regulations related to disability rights.
 
 
 
• **Disability Rights in India**:
 
 
• The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 is a landmark legislation in India that aims to uphold the dignity and rights of persons with disabilities.
 
• The act provides for a range of measures to ensure that persons with disabilities can live with dignity and fully participate in society.
 
• It includes provisions for accessibility, education, employment, and social security.
 
 
 
• **Achievements of Dr. KS Rajanna**:
 
 
• Dr. KS Rajanna has been instrumental in advocating for the rights and welfare of disabled persons in Karnataka.
 
• His efforts have led to the implementation of various programs and initiatives aimed at improving the lives of persons with disabilities.
 
• He has been a vocal advocate for inclusive education and employment opportunities for the disabled.
